description: Sanford, FL – In a new interview, Congressional Candidate Ryan Elijah, who the President said stands for “EVERYTHING MAGA,” was asked his position on how the Iran war was being handled. Elijah has expressed his support for the Iran war previously, saying “We’ve got to finish the job” in Iran. He doubled down on his support for the war, saying Floridians “understand there is a cost of freedom.”
paid_for_by: Paid for by Dalton for Florida Bale Dalton is a former member of the United States Navy and current member of the United States Navy Reserve
title: As Casualties In The Iran War Climb, And Costs Rise, TV Anchor Ryan Elijah Quips: “There Is A Cost Of Freedom” - Bale Dalton
